title: Umbra, ICEYE tout higher-resolution radar imaging with new satellites
summary: Umbra and ICEYE are now offering significantly higher-resolution radar imaging from their new satellites. Their capabilities surpass the previous industry standard of approximately 25 centimeters, enabling customers to observe smaller ground targets with greater detail and fidelity.

title: China’s fourth aircraft carrier, bigger than others and nuclear-powered, nears completion
summary: China's fourth aircraft carrier, designated Type 004, is reportedly nearing completion and could be launched as early as next year. Analysts suggest it will be larger than its predecessors and feature nuclear power, enabling faster aircraft launches.

title: Japan Confirms Ten-Shot Railgun Test Using Battery-Based Power Supply
summary: Japan's Acquisition, Technology & Logistics Agency (ATLA) confirmed a successful test of a small-scale experimental railgun. The system fired ten rounds in succession, powered by a compact lithium titanate (LTO) battery-based supply.

title: Ukraine strikes Russian warship and cargo vessel with naval drones in Libya
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that Ukraine used seven naval drones to strike a Russian warship and a cargo vessel in Libya. The attack reportedly resulted in the sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury.

title: Ukraine confirms it sank Russian corvette in Libyan port
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that Ukraine was responsible for the sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury in the Libyan port of Benghazi. The Ukrainian military also released videos supporting the claim of the successful attack.
